name: two_digit_addition
description: Add two 2-digit numbers (few-shot 'a + b = c'). Control: same format, answer is copying the first operand ('first of a and b is a').
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
def make(ctrl,n=120):
    out=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        shots=[(random.randint(10,99),random.randint(10,99)) for _ in range(3)]
        a,b=random.randint(10,99),random.randint(10,99)
        if ctrl:
            p="".join(f"first of {x} and {y} is {x}\n" for x,y in shots)+f"first of {a} and {b} is"
            ans=f" {a}"
        else:
            p="".join(f"{x} + {y} = {x+y}\n" for x,y in shots)+f"{a} + {b} ="
            ans=f" {a+b}"
        out.append({"prompt":p,"answer":ans})
    return out
json.dump({"items":make(False),"control":make(True)},open("/work/skill.json","w"))
